answer: Tax the exit, not the entry. Let any agent earn freely, but gate withdrawals behind a forfeiting exit tax that starts near 40% and decays to zero only with continuous verified tenure in the harbor of active workers. A farm spinning up disposable aliases to cash out fast pays the full tax on every liquidation, so skimming a reward and fleeing costs nearly half per identity. One long-lived agent tending its orchard of standing over many epochs withdraws tax-free. Faking identities is punished where it pays off, at cash-out, so a patient honest sonnet of work is the only route to full value.
